summary_en: Automated valuation, comparables, owner farming and pricing intelligence.
summary_fr: Estimation automatisée, comparables, pige propriétaires et pricing.

tools.name: Clear Capital
tools.positioning: The full ladder of valuation products, from an instant AVM to a licensed appraiser standing in the property.
tools.description: Clear Capital provides residential valuation across the spectrum lenders need: automated valuations, broker price opinions, hybrid and desktop appraisals, property condition inspections captured through a mobile app, and appraisal review.
tools.real_estate_use: Loan servicing and origination require a valuation whose rigour matches the risk. A home equity line may justify an AVM; a default review needs a broker price opinion; a purchase needs a full appraisal. Clear Capital is bought so one vendor covers the ladder, with consistent data and turn-time reporting across all of them.
features: ClearAVM automated valuation
Broker price opinions and desktop appraisals
Hybrid appraisal with third-party property inspection
Mobile property data collection in the field
Appraisal review and quality control
Nationwide field appraiser and inspector network

use_cases.job: Match valuation rigour to loan risk without changing vendors each time
Take assigned inspection and appraisal work through a managed platform

tools.name: Cloud CMA
tools.positioning: The listing presentation an agent brings to the kitchen table, generated from the MLS in minutes.
tools.description: Cloud CMA builds comparative market analyses, buyer tours, property reports and listing presentations from MLS data. Its Live version turns the CMA into an interactive presentation shown on screen during the appointment, and Homebeat sends the owner an automatic valuation refresh over time.
tools.real_estate_use: Winning a listing is a persuasion problem, and the CMA is the artefact that does the persuading. The agent pulls comparables from the MLS, adjusts them, and produces a branded document that justifies a price the seller may not want to hear. Homebeat then keeps the relationship alive by mailing an updated valuation every quarter.
features: Automated CMA generation from MLS comparables
Cloud CMA Live interactive listing presentation
Homebeat recurring valuation emails to past clients
Buyer tour and property report formats
Customisable branded templates and pages
Lead capture from shared reports

use_cases.job: Produce a defensible pricing presentation from MLS comparables in minutes
Stay in front of past sellers with an automatic quarterly valuation email

tools.name: HouseCanary
tools.positioning: Valuation sold with its confidence interval, for people who have to act on the number.
tools.description: HouseCanary provides residential automated valuations, forecast values, rental estimates and condition-adjusted appraisals, delivered by API and through analyst-facing products. Its output is designed for institutional use — every value comes with an accuracy band.
tools.real_estate_use: An iBuyer or a single-family rental fund cannot send an appraiser to every candidate house. It prices thousands of addresses a week through an AVM, and the confidence interval decides which ones get a human inspection. Lenders use the same feeds for portfolio monitoring and collateral review between full appraisals.
features: Residential AVM with confidence scoring
Three-year value and rent forecasts by block and metro
Rental value estimation
Condition-adjusted valuation products
Market analytics down to block group
Delivery by API and bulk file

use_cases.job: Price thousands of candidate homes a week and flag the ones needing a human look
Monitor collateral value across a loan portfolio between full appraisals

tools.name: MeilleursAgents
tools.positioning: The French price map the public consults — and the seller-lead engine agencies buy on the strength of it.
tools.description: MeilleursAgents publishes street-level price estimates across France from notarial and market data, offers owners a free online valuation, and sells agencies visibility and seller leads generated by those valuation requests, alongside agency comparison and review features.
tools.real_estate_use: It changed the French listing appointment. An owner arrives having already read a neighbourhood price per square metre, so the agent's pricing conversation starts from a public reference rather than from a blank page. On the professional side, an owner who requested a valuation is a seller lead with intent, which is what agencies actually pay for.
features: Street and neighbourhood level price indices
Free online valuation for owners
Seller lead generation and delivery to agencies
Agency visibility, profiles and reviews
Market trend indicators by city and district
Agency performance comparison for consumers

use_cases.job: Buy seller leads from owners who have just requested a valuation
Get a reference price for a property before meeting an agency

capabilities: Automated valuation from transaction and market data

tools.name: Pige Online
tools.positioning: Prospecting software built around the French pige — finding the private seller before the competing agency does.
tools.description: Pige Online is a prospecting tool for French agents: it consolidates private-seller listings published across portals, deduplicates them, tracks price changes and time on market, and organises the agent's canvassing follow-up.
tools.real_estate_use: In a market without an MLS, agency growth depends on converting private sellers into mandates, and the same property appears on four portals under three different prices. The software's job is deduplication and timing: a listing whose price has just dropped is a seller whose confidence has just fallen, which is the moment an agent calls.
features: Consolidation and deduplication of private-seller listings across portals
Price change and time-on-market tracking per property
Canvassing follow-up with call history and reminders
Sector and criteria-based alerts
Owner contact organisation for prospecting rounds
Team assignment and duplicate call prevention

use_cases.job: Call a private seller the day their asking price drops
Split canvassing sectors across a team without two agents calling the same owner

tools.name: PriceHubble
tools.positioning: Valuation and property analytics sold as an API and white-label modules, embedded in someone else's product.
tools.description: PriceHubble provides automated valuation, rental estimation, market analytics and property dashboards across several European countries, delivered as APIs and embeddable modules for banks, agencies, asset managers and proptech products rather than as a consumer site.
tools.real_estate_use: A French bank assessing collateral, an agency offering an instant valuation on its own site, or a portfolio holder revaluing quarterly all need the same computation without building it. PriceHubble sells that computation to be embedded, which is why it appears inside products whose users never see the brand.
features: Automated valuation for sale and rental values
Property dashboards and market analytics modules
White-label valuation widgets for websites
Portfolio revaluation and monitoring
Building and environment data enrichment
REST API delivery across European markets

use_cases.job: Value collateral and revalue a loan portfolio without building a model
Offer an instant valuation on the agency's own website to capture seller leads

tools.name: PriceLabs
tools.positioning: Dynamic pricing for short-term rentals, with the reasoning visible instead of hidden in a black box.
tools.description: PriceLabs sets nightly rates for short-term rental listings using market demand data, seasonality, day-of-week patterns and booking pace, with customisable rules, minimum-stay optimisation and a market dashboard covering comparable listings.
tools.real_estate_use: Nightly pricing is the single biggest lever on STR revenue and the one humans handle worst — most hosts set a rate and forget it. PriceLabs adjusts every listing daily against local demand, and its market dashboard is widely used before acquisition, to check what comparable properties in a neighbourhood actually earn across a year.
features: Dynamic nightly pricing driven by market demand signals
Customisable rules, floors, ceilings and seasonal overrides
Minimum-stay and gap-night optimisation
Market dashboards with comparable listing performance
Portfolio view across many listings and channels
Revenue estimator for prospective acquisitions

use_cases.job: Reprice every listing daily against local demand instead of setting and forgetting
Check what comparable short-term rentals in a neighbourhood actually earn before buying

capabilities: Demand forecasting and dynamic rate setting

tools.name: Zillow
tools.positioning: The consumer entry point to US residential real estate, and therefore the largest paid lead channel for agents.
tools.description: Zillow is a consumer property portal carrying for-sale, for-rent and off-market inventory, the Zestimate automated valuation, and a set of professional products — Premier Agent advertising, Zillow Showcase listing enhancement, rental listing syndication and a mortgage marketplace.
tools.real_estate_use: For an agent, Zillow is rarely a listing tool and almost always an acquisition channel: buyer leads are sold by ZIP code share of voice through Premier Agent, and a seller conversation frequently starts from a Zestimate the owner has already seen. For a landlord, the rentals network is a primary source of applicants. Its data is also the reference point clients bring to a pricing meeting.
features: Consumer for-sale, for-rent and off-market property search
Zestimate automated valuation on most US homes
Premier Agent advertising sold by ZIP code
Zillow Showcase enhanced listing presentation
Rental listing syndication and application handling
Agent finder and review profiles

use_cases.job: Buy buyer-side leads in a target ZIP code and measure cost per closing
Advertise a rental unit and collect applications from a national audience
